implemented: Explicit prepared Traverse→Project(answer:path_node) through ordinary agent binding/P1/backend runtime to strict typed entity terms
tiny_checks: Explicit first/last/interior answer positions and incoming direction with compiled SPARQL on RDFLib
Distinct paths and duplicate facts do not multiply entity answers
Successful empty result remains a complete empty answer
Missing/nonentity/out-of-range projection and nested reference metadata rejected before backend calls
Every replica has the declared snapshot and resource encoding
Observation and selected-execution failures retain attempts without retry
Answer row budget precedes adapter deduplication; duplicate-row injection follows an actual tiny agent run
limitations: Prepared meanings, not model interpretation or GrailQA accuracy
No real Neo4j/Fuseki services used; RDFLib executes SPARQL through a transport override
Legacy150 inference answer contract and real query-independent facts remain missing
Snapshot matching verifies declarations, not actual endpoint contents
Existing planner guarantees remain model-relative and do not cover answer conversion or observed latency
No frozen dataset, oracle, model package, original failed response, or prior accepted gate changed
